3510-3875-5929-8168.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Leyline of Transformation.
3510-3875-5929-8168.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each permanent that entered is a Saproling through Leyline of Transformation and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Provisioner to trigger.
Resolve a Tireless Provisioner trigger, replacing the artifact token creation with that many 5/5 Dragons through Draconic Visitor.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

4694-5226-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4694-5226-5805-7306.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gev.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

1669-3899-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

728-2281-3817.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4063-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Fleshtaker and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat.

1429-1477-4981.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2034-4186-6854--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Repeat from step 5.

3484-5391-7704-7824.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
3484-5391-7704-7824.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1018-1987-6259.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1018-1987-6259.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1018-1987-6259.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

2436-3457-7791.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Marwyn.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Marwyn.
Repeat.

1636-4241-5371-7629.description:
Animate Hourglass of the Lost using Karn.
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
1636-4241-5371-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

659-4381-4460-4613.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-4381-4460-4613.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

4365-4682-4772-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
4365-4682-4772-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Doubling Season and Mondrak.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
4365-4682-4772-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

2837-3490-3755-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
2837-3490-3755-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
Repeat.

141-5256-6819.description:
Cast Vincent's Limit Break by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Vincent's Limit Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Vincent's Limit Break.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities from step 5.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1150-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Melira's Keepers
When Melira's Keepers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2173-3652-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2558-5346-5433-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Crime Novelist and Krenko trigger.
Resolve the Crime Novelist trigger, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on the Crime Novelist.
Resolve the Krenko trigger, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token with haste.
When the Goblin enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Goblin token.
Repeat.

2498-3583-4067.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {1}.
2498-3583-4067.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Oloro's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Oloro's second ability triggers, holding priority, activate a permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Oloro trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Sheoldred triggers. Holding priority, activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping a mana-producing permanent.
Resolve the Sheoldred trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4484-4871-5256-5643-6747.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
4484-4871-5256-5643-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
4484-4871-5256-5643-6747.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4484-4871-5256-5643-6747.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1365-1379-4853-5226--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1379-4853-5226--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Lithatog's first ability by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4050-4053-5944.notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher does not have a counter on it.
4050-4053-5944.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher, adding one mana of any color.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with zero stun counters due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

860-3663-4772.notablePrerequisites: Calix does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
860-3663-4772.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Calix.
Calix's second ability triggers, creating two token copies of Three Blind Mice.
The Three Blind Mice tokens enter the battlefield with two lore counters on them due to Doubling Season, triggering their first and second chapter abilities, as well as Calix's first ability twice.
Resolve both Calix triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on a creature you control.
Resolve the first Three Blind Mice triggers, creating four 1/1 Mouse creature tokens.
Resolve the next Three Blind Mice trigger, creating two token copies of a Three Blind Mice token.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite Three Blind Mice triggers, you may use them to copy any token(s) you control.

1170-1623-3312.description:
Cast any noncreature spell from your hand by paying its mana cost, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Mystic Snake by paying {1}{G}{U}{U}.
Mystic Snake enters the battlefield, exiling the spell and causing you to cast the spell from exile without paying its mana cost due to Guile.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Mystic Snake.
Repeat from step 3.

2173-3693-5220.description:
Cast Walking Ballista either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Walking Ballista enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Walking Ballista from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

4419-4929-5189.notablePrerequisites: Cryptic Trilobite has at least four +1/+1 counters.
4419-4929-5189.description:
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Cryptic Trilobite, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a Saproling, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Saproling token with no counters on it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.
